The speakers feature non-standard, complex geometries with internal mechanical-looking structures, circular drivers, and metallic finishes. They do not resemble traditional rectangular box speakers.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Grille cloth or perforated metal may cover the drivers.

Despite the stylization, the objects are clearly intended to represent audio output devices/speakers.

The perspective of the middle speaker's open cavity seems slightly warped, with edges that don't align perfectly with a consistent vanishing point relative to the other two.
